reports.title: Atmos Energy Corporation Reports Earnings for Fiscal 2026;

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: •Fiscal 2027 earnings per diluted share guidance expected to be in the range of $9.05 - $9.25 per diluted share.
•Fiscal 2027 capital expenditure guidance expected to be approximately $4.5 billion.

•The company's Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.09 per common share. The indicated annual dividend for fiscal 2027 is $4.36, which represents a 9.0% increase over fiscal 2026.
